title: Check: Pollination and Fertilisation in Plants (C)

questions.stem: What is the difference between pollination and fertilisation in plants?

options.text: Pollination only occurs in wind-pollinated plants
Pollination is the transfer of pollen to the stigma; fertilisation is the fusion of gamete nuclei

questions.explanation: Pollination is the transfer of pollen from the anther to the stigma. Fertilisation occurs later when the male gamete nucleus from the pollen grain fuses with the female gamete nucleus in the ovule.
